subject: Request: Pilot credit & extension for Solace Labs (accelerator)
messages:
From: Aisha Nadeem <aisha@solacelabs.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie@bluehatch.vc>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot request — extra credits & trial extension

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro and for Redwood’s support of the BlueHatch accelerator cohort. We kicked off our pilot last week and the initial usage has been heavier than expected due to an internal demo day prep. Two quick asks: 1) can we get a short-term top-up of credits to keep the pilot live through the week, and 2) would Redwood consider a trial extension so we can complete the post-demo evaluation (we're asking for +60 days)?

Quick context: the pilot is scoped to 30k tokens/day over 30 days (see attached pilot_scope.xlsx). If we get through the demo week successfully, BlueHatch is likely to recommend a paid trial expansion for a paid POC in Q4.

Attachments: pilot_scope.xlsx (xlsx)

Let me know what details you need — happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Nadeem
Head of Integrations, Solace Labs
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Nadeem <aisha@solacelabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — extra credits & trial extension

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear context and the attachment.

We can scope an exception for accelerator cohorts but I need a quick internal check on the numbers and compliance items (SSO/KMS for the later POC). Proposed response: a one-time credit top-up of 60k tokens to cover the demo week and a conditional +60 day trial extension contingent on: (a) a signed memorandum of agreement (MoA) outlining milestones, (b) SSO configured for your pilot environment, and (c) a short usage milestone check at day 30.

If that works for you we'll prepare the MoA and route for signatures. Ben, Jordan — looping you in for technical and program confirmation. Ben, can the runtime team cover the 60k top-up without impacting capacity SLAs? Jordan, can you confirm whether the BlueHatch partnership allows for this exception and if we should attach any partner promo terms to the MoA?

Aisha — attaching a place-holder milestone doc I put together (solace_milestones.pdf). If you can confirm milestones we will expedite legal.

Attachments: solace_milestones.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request — extra credits & trial extension

FYI — forwarding for technical sign-off and a quick ask to Marissa on approval thresholds.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — extra credits & trial extension
To: Aisha Nadeem <aisha@solacelabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Kimberly — thanks. Quick notes from my side: technically we're good to allocate the 60k token top-up. The runtime team can create a temporary promo bucket that doesn't affect tenant steady-state capacity; we should monitor the burst to avoid upstream throttling.

Two items: 1) because this is an accelerator cohort with BlueHatch, I'd recommend we expand to 75k tokens as a goodwill gesture — it helps reduce the risk of them hitting limits in demos and increases the likelihood of conversion. 2) If we increase to 75k, we should add a one-time usage milestone at day 14 to ensure there isn't sustained spike behavior.

Marissa — this is a asks-for-exception scenario. Our current approval matrix requires director sign-off for >50k token one-offs tied to partner promos. Can we approve 75k and 60-day extension for this cohort (deal SOL-3472)?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — extra credits & trial extension

Approved with conditions.

Marissa here — I reviewed Solace’s attachment and Ben’s technical note. Approve a one-time top-up of 60,000 tokens (we'll notate it as a 60k promo bucket) and a +60 day extension to the trial. I do not approve the 75k uplift at this time; stick to 60k. Conditions before credits are provisioned:

- Signed MoA (legal will do a redline; Kimberly please send the draft to the Solace contact)
- SSO must be configured (security sign-off)
- We add a Day-14 usage checkpoint and an automatic throttling plan if usage exceeds 140% of the expected daily average for more than 48 hours

Kimberly — please send the draft MoA to Aisha and Jamie and request the signed_moa.pdf back to accelerate provisioning. Jordan — please get the BlueHatch partner terms added to the MoA addendum. Ben — prepare the temporary promo bucket and set up alerts for the Day-14 checkpoint.

I'll mark this as an exception approval in the tracker (Deal: SOL-3472) and will log the decision in the partner exceptions board.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships & Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments requested: signed_moa.pdf (pdf)
